def decompose(text: str) -> str:
    # Compatibility Jamo lists
    INITIALS = [
        'ㄱ', 'ㄲ', 'ㄴ', 'ㄷ', 'ㄸ', 'ㄹ', 'ㅁ', 'ㅂ', 'ㅃ',
        'ㅅ', 'ㅆ', 'ㅇ', 'ㅈ', 'ㅉ', 'ㅊ', 'ㅋ', 'ㅌ', 'ㅍ', 'ㅎ'
    ]
    VOWELS = [
        'ㅏ', 'ㅐ', 'ㅑ', 'ㅒ', 'ㅓ', 'ㅔ', 'ㅕ', 'ㅖ', 'ㅗ',
        'ㅘ', 'ㅙ', 'ㅚ', 'ㅛ', 'ㅜ', 'ㅝ', 'ㅞ', 'ㅟ', 'ㅠ',
        'ㅡ', 'ㅢ', 'ㅣ'
    ]
    FINALS = [
        '',  # no final
        'ㄱ', 'ㄲ', 'ㄳ', 'ㄴ', 'ㄵ', 'ㄶ', 'ㄷ', 'ㄹ', 'ㄺ',
        'ㄻ', 'ㄼ', 'ㄽ', 'ㄾ', 'ㄿ', 'ㅀ', 'ㅁ', 'ㅂ', 'ㅄ',
        'ㅅ', 'ㅆ', 'ㅇ', 'ㅈ', 'ㅊ', 'ㅋ', 'ㅌ', 'ㅍ', 'ㅎ'
    ]

    result = []
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3:  # Hangul syllable
            s_index = code - 0xAC00
            l = s_index // (21 * 28)
            v = (s_index // 28) % 21
            t = s_index % 28
            result.append(INITIALS[l])
            result.append(VOWELS[v])
            if t:
                result.append(FINALS[t])
        else:
            result.append(ch)
    return ''.join(result)
